acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

The peptides were fractionated on Easy-nLC 1200 (Thermo Fisher) by reverse-phase separation on a nanocapillary column packed with C18 material (Dr. Maisch GmbH, Ammerbuch, Germany) during a 2 h gradient from 4 % to 35 % ACN (VWR) and measured using data-dependent acquisition on an Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: In gel digest was performed by mincing the gel pieces, reduction with DTT (Sigma-Aldrich), alkylation with IAA (Sigma-Aldrich) and subsequent digest with MS-grade trypsin (Serva, Heidelberg, Germany).
